title: The Sky Shadow
text: A shadow vast as a cloud sweeps over the party, and the birds go silent. The air smells of smoke. Something circles high above, too high to see clearly, a long dark shape against the sun.

options.label: Take cover and wait, praying it is not hungry.

outcomes.text: It passes, though you lose hours under the smell of smoke.

options.label: The sharpest watches where it lands, so you know where not to go.

outcomes.text: They see its lair, and learn when it leaves.

options.label: The Leader signals it to learn what it wants.

outcomes.text: It is an old dragon, curious, and it gives you a ride.
It is a young dragon, and hungry.
